# Vacancy research: 322 Broadway, Oakland (APN 001-013901400)

**Verdict:** unknown  
**Confidence:** 0.20  
**Estimated vacancy start / duration:** not estimable from available public evidence.

The public record supports ongoing rehabilitation but does not establish current occupancy or an uninterrupted vacancy period. Realtor.com lists the property as under construction and records residential building alteration and electrical permits issued in 2026. A 2025 Jack London Improvement District update says rehabilitation changed course with new ownership. Listing history shows a 2023-2025 sale campaign and a March 2025 sale. These facts can coincide with vacant premises, but do not prove it; a multi-unit mixed-use property may also be partly occupied during phased work. No dated utility shutoff, official vacancy declaration, confirmed code finding, or dated occupancy evidence was located.
